notes: Session fixation in Apache Tomcat FORM authentication. Session ID not rotated after login — attacker pre-sets session ID. Fixed by adding invalidate_old_session() before creating new session.
Session fixation in Django admin. Session key not rotated when user logs in via admin interface — old session remains valid. Fixed by adding rotate_session_key() after login.
Session fixation via stale JWT in Flask. Token verified but session freshness not checked — expired tokens remain valid. Fixed by adding validate_session_freshness() before granting access.
Session fixation via OAuth token reuse in Keycloak. Old refresh tokens remain valid after re-authentication. Fixed by invalidating existing tokens before issuing new ones.
Session fixation in Next.js middleware. Cookie validated but session not regenerated — attacker can replay captured cookies. Fixed by adding regenerate_session() after validation.
